mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer_tag (tenant_id, customer_id, tag_code, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{tagCode}, #{createdBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM crm_customer_tag WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND tag_code = #{tagCode}

DELETE t FROM crm_customer_tag t INNER JOIN crm_customer_tag p ON p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND p.customer_id = #{toCustomerId} AND p.tag_code = t.tag_code WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.customer_id = #{fromCustomerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer_tag SET customer_id = #{toCustomerId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{fromCustomerId}
